label: DHCPv6
notes: DHCPv6 client/server message header (RFC 8415 §16, formerly RFC 3315 §5.1) over UDP ports 546 (client) and 547 (server/relay agent). The 4-byte header is modelled in full: the message-type byte and the 24-bit transaction-id, which spans bytes 1-3 and is read through a single masked 4-byte window at offset 0 (a 3-byte read is not a BPF load width; the mask isolates the transaction bytes). Options (client/server DUID, IA_NA, status codes, ...) follow at byte 4 as a variable TLV chain with no fixed offsets. Relay messages (types 12/13) carry hop-count and link/peer addresses instead of a transaction-id — a different layout not covered by this entry beyond the type byte itself.

fields.label: Message Type
fields.description: DHCPv6 message type; 12/13 identify relay messages whose body carries no transaction-id (different layout).

fields.label: Transaction Id
fields.description: 24-bit id chosen by the client and echoed by the server; groups the messages of one lease transaction.
